prop:bellman.scope: Normalized finite discounted MDP: convergent expected-return series, unique policy and optimal Bellman fixed points, pure greedy optimum, randomized-policy domination and arbitrary tied greedy choices.

thm:shapley_bellman.scope: Exactly layered finite stochastic game with common nonempty action type: unique Bellman values and pure stationary saddle versus all normalized randomized policies at every layered state. Does not assert arbitrary-DAG encoding or unique policies.

thm:relu_net_game_value.scope: Actual normalized ReLU game with nonzero fan-in and forced ungated affine output: saddle against all randomized profiles, exact selected payoff, exact all-subgame iff tie-permitted 0/1 gate conditions, and same output payoff for every subgame-perfect profile. Direct recursive all-state randomized best-response predicate on Strategy iff both players continue with probability one at strictly positive preactivations and zero at strictly negative ones; arbitrary probabilities permitted at ties.

obs:tropical_convex_cpwl.scope: Exact scalar convex CPWL iff finite max-affine representation, derived from the genuine finite closed-polyhedral cover by dense interiors and convex local-to-global minima; no representation assumption or substitute CPWL definition.

lem:support_properties.scope: Full nonempty compact-convex support calculus; arbitrary compact convex sets for convexity, homogeneity, sums/unions, containment and uniqueness; separate nonempty finite hull formula and extreme-point attainment.

prop:newton_calculus.scope: Actual Newton sets under tropical addition/maximum, exact function identities, homogenized slice support and zero-intercept unlifted support.

thm:split_tropical_rational.scope: Bias-free hidden network and ungated signed affine readout: constructed heads have zero intercepts, nonnegative slopes, monotonicity, convexity, positive homogeneity; exact actual split affine-head evaluations, exact signed logit difference and final weighted Minkowski sets. Includes zero hidden layers.

thm:monotone_nonneg_gradients.scope: Nonnegative directional derivative at differentiable points; no subdifferential theorem.

cor:minkowski_propagation.scope: Actual basis-singleton initial sets, every hidden weighted Minkowski/hull propagation, and both ungated signed affine output sums, including arbitrary stored biases and zero hidden layers.

prop:subdifferential_face.scope: Nonempty finite-hull support: actual subgradient inequality iff maximizing face, genuine Frechet differentiability iff singleton exposed face, and every attained gradient lies in the hull.

cor:polytopes_nonneg.scope: Both actual Newton convex hulls of constructively propagated network split polynomials are contained in the nonnegative orthant.

thm:vertices_gradients.scope: Arbitrary positively homogeneous convex CPWL function: existence and uniqueness of its nonempty Newton polytope and exact equality of its extreme points with all genuine Frechet gradient vectors. cor:dc_split_endpoint.scope: Literal eta-one identity with the actual DC split, exact reconstruction, convexity under arbitrary convex input lifts, and actual final affine-head convexity/recovery.

Full shared biased network and actual ungated signed affine readout recover the conjugate-activation network.
